definitions.explanation: Energy released by nuclear reactions, especially nuclear fission, used for generating electricity or other purposes.

examples.japanese: {原子力|げんしりょく}{発電所|はつでんしょ}が{稼働|かどう}している。
examples.english: The nuclear power plant is operating.

examples.japanese: {原子力|げんしりょく}の{平和|へいわ}{利用|りよう}を{推進|すいしん}する。
examples.english: To promote the peaceful use of nuclear energy.

examples.japanese: {原子力|げんしりょく}{規制|きせい}{委員会|いいんかい}が{審査|しんさ}を{行|おこな}う。
examples.english: The Nuclear Regulation Authority conducts inspections.

notes:
COMPOSITION: {原子|げんし} (atom) + {力|りょく} (power). Literally "atomic power."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{原子力|げんしりょく}{発電|はつでん} (nuclear power generation)
・{原子力|げんしりょく}{発電所|はつでんしょ}/{原発|げんぱつ} (nuclear power plant)
・{原子力|げんしりょく}{規制|きせい}{委員会|いいんかい} (Nuclear Regulation Authority)
・{原子力|げんしりょく}の{平和|へいわ}{利用|りよう} (peaceful use of nuclear power)
・{原子力|げんしりょく}{潜水艦|せんすいかん} (nuclear submarine)

ABBREVIATION: {原発|げんぱつ} is a common abbreviation for {原子力|げんしりょく}{発電所|はつでんしょ}.

JAPAN CONTEXT: Following the 2011 Fukushima Daiichi accident, Japan's nuclear policy has been subject to significant debate. Key terms:
・{再稼働|さいかどう} (restart of nuclear plants)
・{廃炉|はいろ} (decommissioning)
・{使用済|しようず}み{核燃料|かくねんりょう} (spent nuclear fuel)

RELATED TERMS:
・{核|かく}エネルギー (nuclear energy)
・{放射能|ほうしゃのう} (radioactivity)
・{風力|ふうりょく}{発電|はつでん} (wind power generation)
・{水力|すいりょく}{発電|はつでん} (hydroelectric power)
